notes: SUNToken mints its entire fixed supply to its deployer once. The external launch factory handles the 90% pool and 10% swarm distribution. Only outgoing PoolManager transfers incur the immutable 0.5% creator tax; transfers into PoolManager and between ordinary wallets are untaxed. No treasury tax, admin, owner, mint, burn, proxy, governance or application contracts. The fixed pool fee is 1.25%. initialPrice is provenance; the launch derives the opening price from the economics and deployed currency order.
